screen.waves.title: Waves · Ocean Settings
screen.waves.active: Mod waves connected to Iris · settings are live
screen.waves.unsupported: No wave hook or exclusive water material ID in this pack
screen.waves.note: Client visuals and audio only. Disable your shader pack's own water displacement.
tooltip.waves.amplitude: Calm-weather displacement in blocks. Scaled by weather; final amplitude is capped at 6 blocks.
tooltip.waves.wavelength: Primary wavelength in blocks. Longer waves produce ocean swells.
tooltip.waves.speed: Wave propagation speed multiplier. Zero freezes animation.
tooltip.waves.direction: Dominant wave direction in degrees; eight directional components overlap.
tooltip.waves.thunder: Amplitude multiplier at full thunder, at least the rain multiplier.
tooltip.waves.transition: Weather smoothing time constant in seconds.
tooltip.waves.sea_level: Default Overworld sea level is Y=63. Adjust for custom worlds.
screen.waves.disabled: Waves are disabled: water will remain flat
screen.waves.wrong_dimension: Overworld only: waves are off in this dimension
screen.waves.zero_amplitude: Amplitude is zero: water will remain flat
tooltip.waves.irregularity: Directional spread, phase warping and changing wave groups reduce evenly spaced rows.
tooltip.waves.shore_fade: Short near-shore transition retaining at least 72% wave height, avoiding a pinned water band.
tooltip.waves.reflection: Visual reflected ripples near actual solid blocks. Not a fluid dynamics simulation.
tooltip.waves.foam: Surface foam in the native renderer. Third-party packs retain their own surface shading.
tooltip.waves.splash_density: Density of budgeted spray when rising crests reach nearby solid obstacles.
screen.waves.native: Native Mod waves · no shader pack needed
tooltip.waves.sound_volume: Continuous recorded surf near shore, fading out offshore. Respects Ambient volume.
tooltip.waves.splash_height: Upward launch velocity multiplier. Droplets have gravity, drag and block collision.
tooltip.waves.splash_size: Vanilla SPLASH particle size multiplier. Density, launch height and size are independent.
tooltip.waves.sound_distance: Distance from shore where looping surf becomes audible. Fades with proximity, independent of wave peaks and particles.
tooltip.waves.runup_reach: Maximum connected land reach in blocks. Requires the wave to exceed ground and intervening barriers.
tooltip.waves.runup_opacity: Opacity of the client-only shore sheet; does not modify blocks or fluids.
tooltip.waves.runup_retreat: Water-sheet decay time after the crest recedes, avoiding abrupt coverage changes.
tooltip.waves.wind_volume: Separate wind loop volume. Automatically fades out in clear weather.
tooltip.waves.wind_pitch: Lower pitch produces a deeper storm-wind sound.
tooltip.waves.wind_thunder: Wind intensity in a full thunderstorm, at least the rain strength.
tooltip.waves.wind_gusts: Slow wind-volume variation; zero is steady wind. Does not restart the recording.
